name: ts-rust-node-api-add
description: Learn to call a Rust add function from TypeScript with napi-rs

scripts.build: npm run build::native && npm run build:ts
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint:rust && npm run typecheck
scripts.clean: cargo clean && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:ffs'; for (const path of ['build', 'dist']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
